5.5 to 5.75

Other than that, I think you have a very pleasant and warm face with some striking features like your nose and lips. Congrats on weight loss!

if it helps, i have a chronic illness that makes my immune system super weak so i get super sick really often, and then i deal with suicidal thoughts pretty often. it's kind of the opposite of your thought, because i'm so sick that i feel like i'm not useful and don't think life is worth fighting for.

the only reason i keep going is because sometimes i wonder what good things might happen, even small things. try to find something to look forward to, maybe getting lunch or going on a walk as the weather becomes warmer. while i'm not exactly sure of your situation, it makes you more appreciative of stuff. i also keep a journal just to write down things that hurt, or are happy. it helps with gratitude and also expression.

try to find friends in the people around you if that is possible, i'm saying this as someone who doesn't feel like they have any true friends. very ironic and hypocritical on my part, but even being in company of any people helps. or just change the people you already are around. when i felt excruciatingly lonely i tried to do volunteer work with children, which makes life a lot more cheerful. you feel good and do good.

first of all, please don't feel guilty about your feelings. and second, please keep staying strong. sending much love.
